title: Consultor(a) | Arquiteto de Redes 4G/5G e IP E2E | RJ ou BH (Banco de talentos)
description:
Description

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando Consultor(a) | Arquiteto de Redes 4G/5G e IP E2E no time de Infrastructure & Real Estate. Na sua rotina, você irá

  • Ser responsável por projetos estratégicos de redes e conectividade.
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de soluções de conectividade customizadas para ambientes industriais e corporativos.
  • Realizar o planejamento e arquitetura de redes móveis 4G/5G fim a fim (E2E), do RAN ao Core, com foco em equipamentos de fornecedores como Nokia e Huawei, além de CPEs industriais (AVI, Teltonika, Nokia, Peplink, Huawei, Fortinet).
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas de redes IP (Layer 2 e Layer 3), incluindo LAN, WAN, SD-WAN e Wi-Fi, com diferencial para conhecimento em infraestrutura Cisco e Huawei.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de VPN utilizando tecnologias como DMVPN, IPSEC, GRE, L2TP, SpeedFusion, Wireguard, Zerotier, entre outras.
  • Aplicar regras de firewall e conceitos de zonas de segurança (TI, DMZ, IDMZ, OT), garantindo a integridade e segmentação das redes.
  • Atuar em projetos de integração entre redes TI e OT, considerando requisitos de segurança, desempenho e escalabilidade.
Requirements

Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Planejamento de Redes 4G/5G E2E (do RAN ao Core).
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Planejamento de Redes IP (Layer 2 e Layer 3).
  • Experiência em Arquiteturas de Redes Empresariais e Industriais, abrangendo redes TI e OT, e suas interconexões.
  • Experiência com tecnologias e arquiteturas VPN (DMVPN, IPSEC, GRE, L2TP, SpeedFusion, Wireguard, Zerotier, entre outras).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo de trabalho híbrido.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Regras de Firewall e conceitos de Zonas de Segurança (como TI, DMZ, IDMZ, OT).
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de conectividade IoT (Zigbee, LoRa, MQTT, Modbus, LTE-M, Nb-IoT).
  • Conhecimento em Arquiteturas Satelitais (LEO e MEO) para soluções em regiões remotas.
  • Experiência em Cloud Computing.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com equipamentos; de fornecedores como Nokia e Huawei, além de CPEs industriais (AVI, Teltonika, Nokia, Peplink, Huawei, Fortinet).
  • Conhecimento em redes de Cisco e Huawei.
  • Certificações relacionadas, como CCNA, CCNP, HCIA ou HCIP.
Benefits

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar
Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
    • Canal de apoio psicológicoe Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

title: 715 - Arquiteto(a) de Dados & Governança (Data Architect) SR
description:
Início: Assim que aprovado

Prazo: 3 meses renováveis

Atividades: Arquiteto(a) de Dados & Governança com sólida experiência em arquitetura de soluções, liderança técnica e governança corporativa em ambientes de dados modernos. O(a) profissional terá como missão definir e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis em plataformas Lakehouse, promover boas práticas de governança e DataOps e atuar como líder estratégico para times técnicos e de negócio, conectando dados a valor corporativo em escala global. Responsabilidades Principais Arquitetura de Soluções Projetar arquiteturas Lakehouse modernas, utilizando plataformas como Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Lakehouse Federation). Definir padrões de ingestão e transformação (batch, streaming, eventos) com Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Liquid Clustering. Modelar dados em arquiteturas Medallion (Raw, Silver, Gold), incluindo camadas de consumo (serving, APIs, BI, ML). Estruturar integrações com sistemas legados, SaaS, SAP, DMS, ERPs e aplicações corporativas. Apoiar projetos de Data Mesh e domínios de dados, com foco em escalabilidade e ownership. Conectar dados a Analytics, Data Science e GenAI, viabilizando casos de uso avançados (predição, recomendação, copilots). Avaliar e recomendar padrões arquiteturais (streaming-first, event-driven, real-time analytics). Conduzir design reviews e provas de conceito para novas soluções de dados. Apoiar estratégias de custo otimizado (compute, storage, caching, auto-scaling). Documentar e disseminar blueprints corporativos de arquitetura de dados. Governança e Estratégia Definir e operacionalizar frameworks de Data Governance corporativa (catálogo, glossário, lineage, ownership, stewardship, qualidade). Implantar políticas de segurança, privacidade e compliance (LGPD, GDPR, HIPAA), incluindo anonimização e criptografia. Estabelecer políticas de classificação de dados (sensibilidade, retenção, criticidade) aplicadas em catálogos e camadas de dados. Conduzir avaliações de maturidade em governança de dados e elaborar roadmaps de evolução. Apoiar o desenho e execução de modelos operacionais de governança (Hub & Spoke, centralizado, federado). Introduzir automações de governança com Unity Catalog, AI/GenAI para classificação, lineage automático e sugestão de glossário. Conduzir processos de definição de ownership e stewardship com áreas de negócio. Estabelecer métricas e KPIs de governança (cobertura de catálogo, nível de qualidade, adoção de glossário, acessos). Apoiar iniciativas de AI Governance, incluindo catalogação e ciclo de vida de modelos. Atuar como ponte entre times de negócio, segurança e engenharia, garantindo adoção e alinhamento corporativo. Liderança Técnica Atuar como referência técnica e arquitetural, orientando engenheiros, analistas e cientistas. Conduzir revisões de arquitetura e propor blueprints de dados corporativos. Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e executivos. DataOps e Automação Implementar CI/CD de dados com GitLab/GitHub, Terraform e Databricks Asset Bundles. Garantir qualidade de dados com testes automatizados (DQX, Pytest, SQLFluff). Apoiar práticas de MLOps com MLflow, Feature Store e monitoramento de modelos. Explorar uso de GenAI e automação inteligente em governança e qualidade.

Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de dados moderna (Lakehouse, Medallion).

Sólida atuação em Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Federation).

Domínio em Python para pipelines e automações.

Vivência prática em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, Azure).

Conhecimento em Data Governance, segurança e compliance.

Diferenciais:
Certificações Databricks, AWS e/ou Azure.

Vivência em Data Catalog, Data Quality e AI Governance.

Experiência em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hub).

Participação em projetos globais de Analytics, Advanced Analytics e GenAI.

title: coordenador enfermagem ambulatorial regional
description:
Responsável por coordenar, supervisionar e padronizar as atividades de enfermagem nas unidades ambulatoriais sob sua jurisdição, garantindo a qualidade da assistência, o cumprimento das normas legais e institucionais, e a integração com as demais áreas da saúde. Atua como elo entre as equipes locais e a gestão central de enfermagem, promovendo a excelência nos serviços prestados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Supervisionar a área de sua responsabilidade e todas as atividades de enfermagem para assegurar assistência adequada aos pacientes de modo a garantir que os pacientes recebam assistência imediata e eficiente, respondendo integralmente por todos os procedimentos executados pelas equipes de Enfermeiros, Técnicos e Auxiliares de enfermagem;
  • Dimensionar o quadro de pessoal de enfermagem da unidade em que atua para bom funcionamento dos serviços, distribuindo quantitativa e qualitativamente a equipe de acordo com a complexidade e especificidade das demandas;
  • Analisar e avaliar os cuidados de enfermagem prestados aos pacientes e garantir a execução, bem como manter monitoramento contínuo das unidades, verificando condições de trabalho recursos materiais e humanos;
  • Disseminar junto à equipe assistencial de enfermagem composta por Enfermeiros, Técnicos e Auxiliares, os objetivos propostos, focando a segurança técnica com relação ao paciente e a importância da satisfação do cliente;
  • Orientar a equipe sobre a assistência de enfermagem, convocar e presidir reuniões e realizar visita diária aos pacientes do setor, avaliando a assistência prestada;
  • Efetuar o controle patrimonial de materiais e equipamentos e utilização correta dos mesmos, evitando o uso incorreto e, consequentemente, danos desnecessários, conforme treinamentos e orientação da Engenharia Clínica;
  • Verificar se os procedimentos emanados pelo Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar (SCIH) estão sendo cumpridos na integra, bem como observar se os manuais internos de procedimentos estão atualizados e sendo considerados em cada procedimento de enfermagem;
  • Colaborar com os setores ligados ao Serviço de Enfermagem tais como: Educação Continuada, Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar etc., seguindo e adotando os treinamentos e orientação por eles dirigidos;
  • Elaborar relatórios mensais de desempenho do setor no aspecto qualitativo e quantitativo, considerando sua força de trabalho e recursos disponibilizados, aplicando instrumentos próprios para mensurar o padrão de atendimento, bem como notificar possíveis intercorrências à Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Cooperar com a Educação Continuada no desenvolvimento de suas programações, agindo e orientando sua equipe com relação à adoção de procedimento de multiplicador dos ensinamentos adquiridos;

  • Acompanhar o resultado mensal da área de atuação intervindo com medidas saneadoras de contenção ou se necessário de ampliação sempre que se fizer necessário, obtendo antecipadamente a aprovação da Gerência;
  • Desenvolver programas de Educação em Serviço a fim de garantir a utilização máxima de habilidade e potencial da equipe de trabalho, bem como elaborar e coordenar, juntamente aos Enfermeiras das unidades, treinamentos e reciclagens, específicos para os setores;
  • Cumprir as Normas e Leis de Trabalho seguindo as orientações provenientes das Gerências de Enfermagem e Recursos Humanos;
  • Favorecer o aprimoramento do conhecimento técnico e cientifico da equipe, estimulando o desenvolvimento de trabalhos científicos e a participação em eventos relacionados à área;Atuar nos processos relacionados ao fluxo do paciente, garantindo a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem prestada;

title: Junior Analyst/Analyst, Economics
description:
About CPI

Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. CPI has seven offices around the world in Brazil, India, Indonesia, Kenya, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

In Brazil, CPI has a partnership with PUC-Rio. CPI/PUC-Rio supports public policies in Brazil through evidence-based research and strategic partnerships with members of the government and civil society.

Position Summary

Under the supervision of a Senior Analyst and guidance of the Program Director, the Junior Analyst/ Analyst will participate in the development of robust and careful empirical analysis of agriculture, land use, energy, and infrastructure development. The ideal candidate for the position is focused, self-driven, and empirically curious. CPI expects the Analyst to produce high-quality materials under demanding deadlines, so the ideal candidate must also systematically demonstrate acute attention to detail and a strong capacity to prioritize when simultaneously tackling multiple tasks. The Analyst will also help in drafting policy reports and will interact with policymakers and stakeholders in the private, public, and non-profit sectors.  

In conducting analysis, the Analyst is required to work in close cooperation with a range of partners from the policy, finance, and corporate spheres, as well as with CPI teams throughout the world.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Includes the following and others as assigned:

Data Handling and Analysis: Effectively manage diverse data formats, (collect, clean, and process) in various formats from diverse sources, constructing and executing procedures for statistical and econometric analyses.

Analytical Output: Generate and format analytical outputs, including tables, graphs, and maps to visually represent research findings.

Content Production: Collaborate closely with the Communications team in the writing and editing of high-quality CPI products, encompassing technical papers, comprehensive reports, policy briefs, white papers, and presentations.

Engagement and Communication: Engage with policymakers, researchers, and stakeholders from the private and non-profit sectors throughout the research process. Communicate the implications of research findings effectively.

Research Integrity: Strictly adhere to transparent and reproducible research requirements in the execution of daily tasks.

Other: Be open to (domestic) travel if required to fulfill job responsibilities.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

Essential:

  • Commitment to CPI's mission and values.
  • BA or BS degree required with coursework in finance, economics, and policy.
  • Proven experience with data management and analytics (R or Python).
  • Verbal and written proficiency in Portuguese and English languages.
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.

Beneficial

  • Master's degree in economics, Finance, Public Policy, or a related, quantitatively rigorous field strongly preferred.
  • Previous professional experience in a relevant field, ideally with a focus on agriculture, energy, infrastructure and land use.
  • Experience analysing economics of policy choices, and/or energy, infrastructure, adaptation, agriculture/land use finance.

Personal Attributes 

  • Independent, analytical mind with a track record of applying sound political and strategic judgment to complex issues
  • Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for working as part of a team, and an ability to interact with a diverse array of people
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and prioritization skills, and an ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines,
  • Strong Portuguese and English written and verbal communications skills.

Position details

CPI is recruiting for one full-time position in our Rio de Janeiro office.

CPI has adopted a hybrid working policy whereby staff are able to mix working remotely with two regular days in the Rio de Janeiro office.

CPI offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 20 days leave + office closure between Christmas and New Year, 5 days study leave, $500 training budget, health insurance.

Salaries are based on experience and market.

To apply

Please submit the following documents 

  • CV/resume no longer than 2 pages;
  • A compelling cover letter outlining why you want to work with CPI and how your skills and experience align with the above requirements. 

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Please add  to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.

Applications deadline.

November 30th 2025

CPI Commitment

Climate Policy Initiative is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we are working to embed DEI across every facet of our organisation. We seek to establish a working environment where all board members, staff, volunteers, and contractors feel respected and valued regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation or identity, disability, education, or any other bias. We want to create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are openly valued as critical to the success of our organization and the achievement of our mission and vision.

If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Canonical's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang.

We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions.

If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do


  • Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team.
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale.
  • Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.
  • Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events.

    • Who you are


  • You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python.
  • You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure.
  • You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them.
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform.
  • You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree.
  • You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people.
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable.
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated.

    • About Canonical


    Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world's #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.  Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world's best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace.

    What Canonical offers:


    Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

    Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


    We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Tidio is the customer service platform that aligns AI and people, so businesses can scale without losing trust or the human touch. Our goal is to help entrepreneurs grow by making customer service more efficient while keeping it helpful.

A few facts about us:

  • Our product is one of the world's leading AI customer service solutions, and our goal is to become no. 1

  • We are among the Top 50 AI and Customer Service Products in G2's Best Software Awards 2024.

Would you like to see what working with us looks like? Check out our #GrowWithTidio video

We are looking for the next hands-on Implementation Specialist to join our small, agile team of 2, helping clients unlock the full potential of Tidio. You will design and implement tailored solutions, integrate Tidio with other tools, and guide clients through adoption and post-implementation care. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams, you will ensure smooth adoption, solve real challenges, and make a tangible impact on client success.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and takes ownership of projects that directly impact client success and Tidio's growth.

As the Implementation Specialist, you will:

  • Set up and configure client accounts, ensuring a smooth start to their Tidio experience.

  • Work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to align solutions with client goals.

  • Identify and drive process improvements, helping to streamline and scale the implementation workflow.


You are the perfect fit if you have:

  • Have a background in Implementation, Technical Onboarding, or Services, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • Are fluent in English (C1 level) and can clearly explain technical details to non-technical users.

  • Have experience working directly with clients via written communication and video calls.

  • Understand APIs and JSON structures and can analyze or test requests.

  • Have solid knowledge of CX platforms such as Tidio, Zendesk, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

  • Can evaluate technical requirements and design solutions that meet real client needs.

  • Have experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve integration or feature gaps.

  • Proactively solve problems, bring creative ideas, and consistently deliver results.

  • Have basic coding experience, e.g., JavaScript or Python (nice to have).

We would like to offer you:

  • A chance to work with one of the top AI products in the customer experience industry.

  • Hands-on growth and technical mastery – deepen your technical and soft skills by implementing solutions that are often critical for clients' business success.

  • Ownership and cross-functional impact – Lead end-to-end complex projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a direct impact on both client success and Tidio's growth.

  • Work with a team that continually shares knowledge and is not afraid of testing new solutions,

  • Remote work model with flexible hours.

  • Possibility to work from one of our offices in Szczecin/Warsaw or access to coworking spaces in your city.

  • 26 days off guaranteed in a year.

  • Great development opportunities – company-supported courses and conferences

  • Individual work tools—MacBook Pro, Dell screen, JBL headphones? You can tailor the equipment to your needs

  • Sport & wellness benefit (or its equivalent).

  • Regular social events (company-wide offsites, team events).

title: Ubuntu Core Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances. 

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86.  You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Product Ops Sênior
description:
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica para trabalhar de forma híbrida em SP/BH/RJ.

Ao assumir o cargo de Agile Master Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal seráatuar facilitando práticas ágeis, removendo impedimentos, promovendo colaboração e apoiando a evolução cultural, utilizando métricas e ferramentas para garantir alinhamento e entrega contínua de valor.

Você atuará na área de Product Opsdentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto,Tecnologia, Design, Dados, Marketing, CX e time B2B.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA:

  • Implementar e evoluir sistemas de métricas de fluxo (cycle time, throughput, WIP, flow efficiency) com base no Kanban Method.
  • Aplicar estatística, teoria de filas e simulações Monte Carlo para análises preditivas e decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Integrar métricas de produto (discovery e outcome) às métricas de fluxo para avaliar valor entregue.
  • Conduzir mapeamentos de value stream e jornadas de usuários, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Colaborar com trios de produto (PM, Design, Tech Lead) e lideranças para alinhar operações à estratégia.
  • Facilitar discussões sobre outcomes versus outputs, promovendo mentalidade orientada a valor.
  • Projetar e implementar automações de workflows e integrações entre ferramentas (n8n, Jira, Confluence, Rovo AI, MCP Servers, Microsoft Automations).
  • Eliminar trabalho manual e criar sistemas self-service.
  • Aplicar IA para otimização de fluxo e melhoria de processos.
  • Disseminar práticas de flow management em áreas além de produto.
  • Garantir alinhamento estratégico e fluxo de informação entre níveis organizacionais (Flight Levels).
  • Facilitar cadências e práticas que promovam transparência, inspeção e adaptação.
  • Apoiar evolução da maturidade organizacional em gestão de fluxo (Kanban Maturity Model).

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Experiência com gestão de produtos digitais e práticas de flow management.
  • Profundo conhecimento em Kanban Method, métricas de fluxo e previsibilidade (cycle time, throughput, Monte Carlo).
  • Familiaridade com discovery contínua (continuous discovery habits, opportunity solution trees).
  • Conhecimento aplicado de Product Operating Model e Product Operations.
  • Experiência com automação de workflows e integrações.
  • Compreensão de estatística básica, teoria de filas e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks: Flight Levels, Team Topologies, Cynefin, OKRs.

Informações adicionais

Informações adicionais

O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. title: Brazilian Portuguese linguists needed
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we're building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Join Lilt as a Freelance Brazilian Portuguese Linguist

Lilt is seeking highly skilled Portuguese (Brazil) linguists like you to collaborate with us

We are particularly, but not exclusively, interested in the following domains: IT, Marketing, Legal and Finance, Life Sciences.

What We're Looking For

  • Native speaker fluency in Brazilian Portuguese.

  • Minimum 2 years of translation experience and/or Linguistics/Translation degree

  • Proven expertise in translation/localization.

Why Collaborate with Lilt?

  • Partner with a forward-thinking company at the cutting edge of language and AI technology.

  • Payments are made via Tipalti; no more invoicing

If interested, please apply with the English-language version of your Resume/C.V.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn't used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn't there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn't meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT's journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

  • LILT's continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

title: Linux Devices Software Engineer
description:
This role is one of our general tracks. Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels.

We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon.

Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices.

These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware.

But while classic, 'deb' based Ubuntu is ideal for developers, it has too much variability for appliance or connected device environments, where you want to know *exactly* what the state of millions or billions of devices might be. So Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices.

We have several teams that focus on open source for embedded environments. We hire outstanding Linux software engineers with a passion for open source, innovation, cutting-edge hardware and software technologies in general. You will be expected to make significant contributions through high-quality design and code, and to develop your technical leadership.

These roles include:

  • Ubuntu Core and snapd software development 
  • Silicon software and optimisation engineers 
  • Kernel driver and hardware enablement engineers 
  • Hardware-centric Linux QA Engineers 
  • Hardware Certification Engineers 
  • Robotics engineers 
  • Industrial IoT software engineers 
  • Networking software engineers (switching, routing, access and SmartNICs)

At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu and Ubuntu Core across the widest range of devices.

Location: we have remote roles open in every time zone.

What your day will look like


Based on the first round of interviews we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit, and conduct second round interviews with those teams. Our engineers:

  • Work with the latest Linux kernel and open source technologies
  • Deliver Ubuntu for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms
  • Integrate and maintain device-oriented software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed software
  • Collaborate proactively with other globally distributed teams 
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities 
  • Help our customers ship their apps and SDKs on Ubuntu
  • Build device OS images with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Optimise the Ubuntu kernel and libraries for silicon-specific capabilities 
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them 
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind 
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions 
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge 
  • Work usually from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for company events 

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) 
  • Passion for Linux or embedded systems software (e.g. kernel, graphics, Yocto) 
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C, C++, or Rust 
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging 
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation 
  • Experience with firmware, uboot, UEFI, ACPI, DSDT, or boot loaders
  • Experience with power management on PCI ASPM, SATA ALPM, low power profiles 
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V 
  • Experience in board design, bring up, and validation 
  • Experience with electrical engineering design tools (e.g. schematic capture, layout) 
  • Familiarity with Ubuntu development model
  • Performance engineering and security experience 
  • Shell or Python scripting skills 

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior HR Internal Controls Business Analyst
description:
The Senior HR Internal Controls Business Analyst will assist in the execution of FME's compliance program through aligning and rolling-out our HR Services Audit & Compliance program. The role will partner with Internal Controls and local teams to review control findings, assess process gaps, develop and implement mitigating procedures.

Responsibilities

  • HR Controls
  • Responsible for global internal controls design and implementation for HR Services
  • Review local HRS internal controls in alignment to global design and determine if need to remain as local controls
  • Oversee local country-specific controls
  • Create controls-related documentation including standard operating procedures, guidelines, samples
  • Implement localized HR controls on a country level ensuring appropriate process standards and SOD are adhered to
  • Identify and train Control Owners, Subprocess Owners as well as any individual roles identified within the framework on changes to controls
  • Support HR and Payroll Global Process Owners on wider global HR and payroll process designs discussions and HR Service model transition efforts
  • Maintain trackers, inventories and reports to ensure accurate status
  • Incident Reporting
  • Develop and maintain job aids, standard operating procedures, checklists and other tools to facilitate execution of incident reporting
  • Collaborate across HR to review issues that are reported through scheduling discovery sessions
  • Investigate and validate impact, corrective actions, stakeholders ensuring sufficient detail is gathered
  • Compile data and collaborate with Internal Controls to assess severity, pervasivness as well as develop mitigation measures and plans
  • Liase with across the HR organization on implementation on mitigation measures
  • Maintain trackers, inventories and reports to ensure accurate status
  • Prepare and perform centralized reporting across the organization

Inscreva-se e viva uma experiência que une aprendizado, autonomia e propósito.

Somos especialistas em implantar e apoiar processos de S&OP em médias e grandes empresas, com mais de dez anos de mercado e dezenas de implantações bem sucedidas. title: Coordenador(a) de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com perfil estratégico e visão sistêmica para assumir a posição de Coordenador(a) de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente, com foco na preservação da vida, bem-estar das pessoas e na sustentabilidade de nossas operações.

A pessoa Coordenadora de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente será responsável por planejar e gerir programas e iniciativas da área, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e das normas internas, além de fomentar a cultura de prevenção, segurança e responsabilidade ambiental em todas as atividades do Parque Bondinho Pão de Açúcar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão Ambiental: Implementação do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental (ISO 14001), gestão de projetos socioambientais e de indicadores de desempenho ambiental (IDAs – consumo de água, energia, geração de resíduos e emissão de gases de efeito estufa), monitoramento de licenças ambientais, gestão de programas do plano de manejo de área legalmente protegida (unidade de conservação), ações de comunicação, educação e sensibilização ambiental.
  • Programa de Prevenção de Acidentes e Incidentes: Coordenar os programas de prevenção de acidentes do trabalho dos empregados e de terceiros, planejando, orientando e executando a operacionalização dos procedimentos de gestão da segurança do trabalho, bem como os recursos de proteção individual e coletivo.
  • Treinamentos e Campanhas de Segurança: Acompanhar programas de treinamentos e campanhas de segurança e meio ambiente, visando difundir e aprimorar a conscientização e o respeito às políticas e normas de SSMA.
  • Inspeções de Segurança e Ambiental: Coordenar as atividades de planejamento da realização das inspeções de segurança e de aspectos e impactos ambientais, analisando riscos e orientando no estabelecimento de controles, visando à adoção das melhores práticas de segurança das pessoas e de proteção ambiental dos ativos.
  • Controles Legais de SSMA : Estabelecer controles legais e de informações governamentais, através de dispositivos de monitoramento interno, objetivando garantir o cumprimento de toda normatização legal e normas internas, assegurando as condições de segurança, buscando minimizar e/ou neutralizar os riscos nos ambientes de trabalho.
  • Relacionamento com a Comunidade: Coordenar junto ao departamento de Relações com a Comunidade da holding todas as interações com a comunidade ao entorno do Parque, realizando reuniões periódicas para o fortalecimento da relação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Ensino superior completo em Engenharias, ciências biológicas e/ou Gestão Ambiental;
  • Expertise em legislações e normas técnicas aplicáveis à Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente;
  • Vivência com atividades em altura;
  • Excel e PowerPoint avançados.

Será um diferencial, se você tiver:

  • Formação técnica ou pós-graduação em segurança do trabalho

Informações adicionais

  • Vale Alimentação: Benefício pago também durante as férias.
  • Restaurante Interno: Modelo self-service com opções variadas, incluindo opções vegetarianas.
  • PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados: Para celebrarmos os resultados da empresa, colhendo os frutos do seu trabalho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Cuide da sua saúde e de seus dependentes com um dos melhores planos de saúde do mercado. Somos uma empresa preocupada com o bem-estar de todas as pessoas, seguindo nossa política de ações afirmativas: Pessoas com deficiência não pagam coparticipação.
  • Assistência Odontológica: Queremos você sempre feliz com um sorriso no rosto
  • Licença parental: Somos uma empresa cidadã, e para honrar nosso compromisso, temos a licença parental estendida.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Mantenha-se saudável com planos que podem abranger mais de 30 mil academias, estúdios e diversos outros benefícios da plataforma.
  • Gratuidades Bondinho: Muito além de um Parque Duas gratuidades mensais pra você curtir a vista mais linda do Rio de Janeiro com quem você quiser. Este benefício é cumulativo para você levar a família toda ou amigos de uma vez só. Não é um máximo?
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio para a sua família, ajudando a equilibrar trabalho e cuidados com os pequenos.
  • Folga no Aniversário: Celebre seu dia especial com um descanso merecido – um dia de folga no seu aniversário e um pote de Brownie
  • Material Escolar: Reembolso de material escolar dos seus filhos, facilitando o início do ano letivo.
  • Cursos de Idiomas: Invista no seu crescimento pessoal e profissional com descontos especiais em cursos de idiomas.
  • Programa de Incentivo a Idiomas: Já pensou em aprender um idioma e ainda ser reembolsado por isso? Temos um programa de incentivo ao desenvolvimento para profissionais selecionados, conforme regulamento interno.
  • Convênios com Universidades: Descontos em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação, extensivo a familiares.
  • Cartão Natal
  • Cartão SESC: Aproveite uma variedade de vantagens e descontos exclusivos, abrangendo áreas de cultura, lazer, saúde e educação.
  • Clube MMB: Seguros de vida, viagem, residencial, automóvel, saúde, para pets entre outros tipos. Tudo para o seu bem-estar
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Descontos em Empresas Parceiras: Economize com ofertas especiais em produtos e serviços dos nossos parceiros.
  • Triênio: Adicional por tempo de serviço, conforme regulamento interno.

title: Especialista em Prospecção Tecnológica
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que te espera no dia a dia:

  • Definir estratégias e estudos de novas tecnologias com objetivo de planejar tecnologias prioritárias e inovadoras para a empresa;
  • Desenvolver soluções e arquiteturas de rede com o objetivo de atender aos requisitos de novos serviços da empresa focado no mercado empresarial;
  • Executar testes de soluções técnicas e arquiteturas de rede com o objetivo de atender aos requisitos técnicos de serviços focado no mercado empresarial;
  • Desenvolver e apoiar atividades de divulgação de novas tecnologias (workshops, treinamentos, palestras) a fim de disseminar o conhecimento dentro da empresa e para clientes;
  • Produzir especificações técnicas e análise para editais de aquisição de informações e compra (RFI e RFP) de novas tecnologias com o objetivo de implementação dentro da empresa;
  • Produzir e auxiliar análise de consultorias para novas tecnologias com o objetivo de estudo e possível implementação de serviços inovadores;
  • Desenvolver parcerias internas (área de Produtos, Serviços Digitais, Engenharia e TI) e externas (fornecedores, clientes, instituições de ensino e pesquisa) visando prospectar novas tecnologias.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos alguém que:

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Eletrônica, Telecomunicações ou Sistemas e Computação;
  • Certificação em redes CISCO (CCNA, CCNP), JUNIPER ou similar;
  • Certificação em Arquitetura de cloud (AWS, Azure, Google ou similar);
  • Conhecimentos em redes móveis (acesso e core de rede);
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas operacionais de nuvem (Openstack e Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimentos de programação orientada a objetos (JAVA e python);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de inteligência artificial (redes neurais, aprendizado de máquina e modelos de LLM);
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e oral);
  • Visão Estratégica, capacidade de negociação, relacionamento Interpessoal, orientação para Resultados e com capacidade de Auto Aprendizado.

É diferencial:

  • Certificação em redes móveis (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, OPEN RAN);
  • Desejável experiência comprovada em inovação e desenvolvimento de tecnologias de telecomunicações e/ou sistemas e computação;
  • Desejável pós-graduação na área de telecomunicações e/ou sistemas e computação;
  • Espanhol fluente (escrita e oral).

Informações adicionais

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

  • Jornada Flexível;
  • Vale-Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Auxílio para patologias graves;
  • Auxílio ao dependente com deficiência;
  • Benefício Farmácia;
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal;
  • Claro Running;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Combo Colaborador;
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Convênios e Parcerias;
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de casa;
  • E muito mais

Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)

Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer

É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é "Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva".

Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 4º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).

No Brasil, estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos, sendo que, em 2022, tivemos 1,2 milhão de linhas portadas.

E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn, o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro.Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, econômico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro, conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
Provemos soluções em hemoterapia de alta complexidade com foco na segurança transfusional dos pacientes e no atendimento diferenciado junto aos nossos clientes, garantindo o apoio necessário para atuarem com qualidade e eficiência.

Nosso diferenciado modelo de governança clínica e técnica permite que tenhamos capacidade operacional para atendimento em todo território nacional com o mesmo padrão de excelência. Do doador ao paciente, nos Bancos de Sangue e nas Agências Transfusionais, realizamos toda a gestão dos processos, assegurando o mesmo ambiente de qualidade – desde a captação dos doadores até o ato transfusional. Nossos laboratórios de referência em imuno-hematologia avançada permitem tratar os casos complexos com agilidade e eficiência no tempo de resposta.

Se você está motivado(a) a integrar uma empresa em constante expansão, esta é a chance perfeita para você

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar o processo de recebimento, conciliação dos créditos no sistema e identificar inadimplências;
  • Analisar o saldo a receber de Clientes e interagir com demais áreas para reportar as inconsistências;
  • Realizar contatos com os clientes (Hospitais e Operadoras) previamente ao pagamento e cobrança em caso de atrasos;
  • Emitir notas fiscais no devido sistema de gestão e nos sites das prefeituras;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de reports gerenciais;
  • Enviar as documentações pertinentes a inadimplência de clientes para assessoria jurídica, emissão de carta anuência/baixa de protestos;
  • Realizar outras atividades não descritas acima por orientação da liderança;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Gestão Hospitalar, Economia, Contabilidade, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação cursando em áreas afins será um diferencial;
  • Desejável Excel Intermediário e conhecimento em pacote Office;
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência em Contas a Receber/Cobrança na área da saúde;

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro;
  • Modalidade de trabalho híbrido após o período de experiência;
  • Horário de trabalho: Segunda a Quinta das 08h às 18h e Sexta das 08h às 17h;
  • Benefícios: Vale transporte, Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação, Assistência Medica, Assistência Odontológica e Seguro de Vida;

Nos dedicamos pela busca do conhecimento e pela inovação, oferecendo a oportunidade de uma vida mais longa e saudável. title: Process Engineer
description:
Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder into a comprehensive Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solutions provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.

The Energy Plant Unit is proud to announce the establishment of new Global Business Centers marking a significant milestone in our journey toward becoming a project-centric and client-driven organization. This strategic expansion enhances our ability to deliver exceptional project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by seamlessly integrating the upstream cultures of Asia, Europe, and America.

Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the offshore industry.

Hanwha Ocean embarks on a journey to transition from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.

Also, Hanwha Oceans' Energy Plan Unit recently expanded its global footprint by establishing new Global Business Centers with the intention of becoming a project-centric and client-driven business organization. This transformation aims to offer enhanced project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by bridging the upstream culture of three continents across Asia, Europe, and America.

Together with talented people and through leadership, Offshore Business continues to deliver outstanding performance for our customers, partners, and shareholders by moving into its next phase of growth and success.

Position Overview:

The Process Engineer leads and controls process engineering activities. Principal Process Engineer perform checking and review all data requested by Client for approval and provide assessments on performance of engineers. Principal Process Engineer ensures that engineering work and deliverables in the process discipline are accurate and correct to code, standard and project specification. Principal Process Engineer shall be able to analysis to identify optimal solution and communicate these solutions through technical reports. This role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and Asia.

The ideal candidate of the position will have a strong background in Offshore Oil & Gas Industry, be an expert in Topsides Process Engineering, and provide strategic focus in the Topsides Process Engineering for Conceptual/pre-FEED/FEED/EPC(I) projects being bid in the offshore area. This will include FPSO's, FLNG as well as other Fixed and Floating platforms/facilities.

The strategic focus will also include providing support to Hanwha Ocean engineering teams based at Houston/Seoul/Amsterdam and elsewhere as necessary including Conceptual, pre-FEED and FEED for projects in the offshore area in the future

Key Responsibilities:

  • Understand project requirement, scope of work and project schedule.
  • Supervise Senior and Junior Process Engineer performance from the beginning to end of project.
  • Ensure all engineering documents are prepared and developed in accordance with relevant design code, standard and client's project specification.
  • Provide engineering expertise and support or report to Manager of Process to ensure engineering progress meets time line.
  • Ensure process and utility system are optimized, efficient, safe and environmentally compliant.

Assist in Project in Bidding or FEED Stage

  • Provide engineering review and support for bid proposal including estimate of manhour and cost.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, FEED, FEED Verification

Process Engineering

  • To develop process calculations, studies and deliverables
  • Review process simulation and result, including heat and material balances (HYSYS, etc.) for the accuracy of calculation
  • Review all process engineering package and deliverables (Sizing, Calculation, Report, PFD, PID and etc.).

Participation in Various Workshop.

  • Chair HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review and etc.
  • Lead engineers to close out of comment/punches/recommendation from HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review and etc.
  • Manage and report status of comment/recommendations

Control 3rd party and sub-contractor.

  • For special process study, contract, selection through technical evaluation of 3rd party
  • Manage 3rd Party workscope and review/comment/approve of 3rd Party's output.
  • Control sub-contractor for their performance and check quality of diagram from sub-contractor

Participation and Support for Commissioning and Start-up

  • Develop/review relevant philosophies and procedure
  • Provide engineering support for construction, commissioning and operation team

Management of Engineering

  • Ensure that process engineering output align with project objective, schedule and budget.
  • Generate regular progress reports
  • Report engineering outstanding and concern to Discipline Manager with technical summaries of outstanding issues

Problem Solving and Addressing Engineering Concerns

  • Provide engineering expertise for decision making to resolve process related issue
  • Address engineering punches/comment

Coordination and Communication

  • Lead engineering meeting with client, engineering sub-contractor and generate MOM.
  • Coordination with detailed engineering consultant or client, vendors and sub-contractors
  • Manage interface with all relevant discipline to get necessary information for process engineering or to provide data to other discipline for their engineering
  • Raise technical query, RFI (Request for Information) and etc. to get necessary information/Client's approval.
  • Provide clarification/answer to Client's request

Monitoring and Mentoring

  • Teach, instruct and guide less experienced Process Engineers.

Qualifications:

  • At least Bachelor Degree or Master Degree in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in process engineering in the offshore oil and gas industry
  • Extensive knowledge of process engineering practices, principles, industry codes and standards - as well as an understanding of scientific methods of problem-solving.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Process Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre-FEED/FEED or tender stage. Prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g. at a top-tier FPSO contractor) will be preferred.
  • Strong understanding with offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Knowledge of class rule, recognized code, standard and skill of process engineering tools such as Aspen HYSYS, Flarenet, Pipe-net or equivalent and ability to interpret result of process simulation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with strong attention to detail and accuracy. ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work with and to communicate effectively with co-workers, vendors, clients and manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluency in English

title: Instrumentation & Control Engineer - Rio
description:
Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder into a comprehensive Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solutions provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.

The Energy Plant Unit is proud to announce the establishment of new Global Business Centers marking a significant milestone in our journey toward becoming a project-centric and client-driven organization. This strategic expansion enhances our ability to deliver exceptional project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by seamlessly integrating the upstream cultures of Asia, Europe, and America.

Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the offshore industry.

Hanwha Ocean embarks on a journey to transition from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.

Also, Hanwha Oceans' Energy Plant Unit recently expanded its global footprint by establishing new Global Business Centers with the intention of becoming a project-centric and client-driven business organization. This transformation aims to offer enhanced project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by bridging the upstream culture of three continents across Asia, Europe, and America.

Together with talented people and through leadership, Offshore Business continues to deliver outstanding performance for our customers, partners, and shareholders by moving into its next phase of growth and success.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Instrumentation & Control Engineer, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of instrumentation and control systems for major projects, such as FPSO and FLNG facilities. Leveraging your extensive experience and technical expertise in instrumentation engineering, you will provide strategic direction, mentorship, and technical leadership to the engineering team, ensuring the successful execution of projects in accordance with project requirements and industry standards.

The ideal candidate of the position will have a strong background in Offshore Oil & Gas Industry, be an expert in the field of Instrumentation, Control and Automation Engineering, and provide strategic focus in the Concept Engineering for Conceptual/pre-FEED/FEED/EPC(I) projects being bid in the offshore area. This will include FPSO or FLNG facilities as well as other Fixed and Floating platforms/facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and development of instrumentation and control systems for industrial processes, including sensors, transmitters, instrument valves (PCV, On/Off valve, etc), controllers, and final control elements, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and compliance with project specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • To lead and coordinate all project Instrumentation & Control engineering issues related to equipment specification, procurement, and installation design, including but not limited to the preparation of specifications, selection of suppliers, review of vendor data, testing, development and maintenance of the instrument database, etc.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders, including process engineers, electrical engineers, and project managers, to understand project requirements, assess control strategies, and develop technical solutions. Liaison with other disciplines on packages and support the construction site team during installation and commissioning phase.
  • Develop detailed instrument specifications, data sheets, and drawings, including loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, and installation details, using CAD software and other design tools.
  • Ensure that all Instrumentation & Control designs and engineering activities comply with relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations. Review project specifications and client requirements to ensure alignment with project deliverables. Prepare formal responses to comments from classification societies and clients on specifications and drawings.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and technical evaluations to assess the performance, reliability, and safety of instrumentation systems, identifying opportunities for optimization and enhancement.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and designers, reviewing their work, providing feedback, and supporting their professional development in instrumentation engineering.
  • Oversee the installation, commissioning, and startup of instrumentation systems, ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgetary constraints, and quality standards. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the team. Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange to enhance the collective expertise of the engineering team.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, including instrument index, calibration records, standard design methodologies and specifications, maintenance procedures, and safety manuals, ensuring accuracy and completeness for regulatory compliance and as-built documentation.
  • To keep abreast of relevant developments in Instrumentation engineering with respect to the offshore industry in general and the company's business in particular.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in instrumentation engineering, with a focus on design, implementation, and optimization of instrumentation and control systems for industrial processes. Experience in offshore topside design is a plus.
  • Proficiency in CAD software and other design tools used in instrumentation engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of instrumentation principles, practices, and standards (e.g., ISA, IEC), with experience in specifying instrumentation equipment and components.
  • Extensive knowledge of industry standards, industry codes and practices related to offshore engineering and Instrumentation & Control design – as well an understanding of scientific methods of problem-solving.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Proficiency in Instrumentation & Control analysis and design software.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Instrumentation, Control and Automation Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre-FEED/FEED or tender stage. Prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g. at a top-tier FPSO contractor) will be preferred.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring abilities, with a track record of successfully leading design projects, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and achieving project objectives.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess technical challenges, identify solutions, and implement effective control strategies.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively in a dynamic engineering environment.
  • Ability to work with and to communicate effectively with co-workers, vendors, clients.
  • Fluency in English

description:

Estamos em busca de uma Consultora Sênior de Gestão de Mudança Organizacional para atuar em um programa de transformação SAP de alta complexidade, envolvendo redesenho de processos, adoção de melhores práticas e rollout de SAP S/4HANA. Procuramos uma profissional com forte capacidade de articulação executiva, entrega hands-on, governança de stakeholders e domínio metodológico em Change Management aplicado a programas de tecnologia de missão crítica.

Neste papel estratégico, você será responsável por estruturar e orquestrar a estratégia de mudança, promovendo o alinhamento entre áreas, mitigando resistências, acelerando a adoção e sustentando a nova cultura operacional.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia de Gestão de Mudança da transformação SAP, abrangendo comunicação, engajamento, readiness, treinamento e gestão de impactos organizacionais.
